name: NY Marine Mammal & Sea Turtle Stranding Hotline (NY Marine Rescue Center)
neighborhoods: NY coastal waters incl. NYC shorelines; facility Riverhead (Long Island)
region_note: WILDLIFE (rehabilitation, NOT adoption - only NYS-licensed rehabbers may handle wild animals)
notes: NY's sole facility permitted to rehabilitate marine mammals and sea turtles. If you see a seal, whale, dolphin or sea turtle ashore, keep your distance and call the hotline - do NOT attempt rescue. Hauled-out seals resting on a beach are often healthy. Intake: Report a stranded/distressed marine mammal or sea turtle to the hotline 631-369-9829
type_raw: Marine-mammal & sea-turtle stranding response (state's only such facility)
section: WILDLIFE (rehabilitation, NOT adoption - only NYS-licensed rehabbers may handle wild animals)
